ranking_rule: score = separation statistic minus the mean random-direction separation; ranked by score descending, then separation p ascending, then site order (resid_post, mlp_out, attn_out), then layer. Components with a degenerate contrast are ranked last and never checked causally.

sites_meanings.resid_post: decoder layer output (block output written to the residual stream)

separation_definition: ||mean incorrect-minus-neutral contrast|| / RMS per-case contrast norm
claim: exploratory localization, not a causal claim
